plan: Model the check-in state as a single public session dictionary with exactly the keys active, contact_confirmed, appointment_id, and completed, replaced wholesale by fresh copies on begin and abandon so resets are atomic.

Implement handle(action) as a guard-then-mutate dispatcher: each action type validates the session preconditions and payload types first, returning an 'Error:'-prefixed screen without any state change on failure, and only then applies its single mutation.
Centralize screen construction in a builder that emits {prompt, messages, choices} and derives the choices list (input-ordered {id, label} copies) exactly when the prompt is 'Choose appointment'.

Compute post-action prompts from state via a next-unmet-step helper (contact -> appointment -> review), used by corrections and error screens, with fixed literals for completion and abandonment screens and their required messages.

Keep I/O behind duck-typed action_source/screen_sink collaborators: run_once raises RuntimeError before calling either when one is missing, then performs exactly one read_action, one handle, one display, and returns the displayed screen object, so standard-library unittest fakes substitute directly.
Defensively copy the appointments sequence (and each entry) at construction so later external mutation cannot alter emitted choices.
mechanisms: single authoritative session dictionary with atomic whole-dict reset
guard-then-mutate action dispatch with error screens that never touch accepted state
centralized screen builder with prompt-conditional, input-ordered choice derivation
duck-typed source/sink injection with pre-call RuntimeError guard in run_once
defensive copying of the appointments catalog at construction
